extraction.Name: Thomas Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded December 17, 1923, by the Farmer's State Bank, at Carter
extraction.Buyer: Wright and his wife mortgaged the land to the Farmers State Bank at Carter for $300 on September 5, 1923; Wright and his wife conveyed the land by deed to George Smith on January 23, 1924
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739708 issued; land described as South half of Southeast quarter, section 26, township 103, and Lots 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13, section 25, and Lots 0 and 9, north of range 77; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; wife joined in mortgage and deed conveyance
